claim_limit: One state per available temperature and family; aggregate pressure RMSE values use unequal evaluable rows and are not parameter-selection statistics. Only vle_obs_0208 was evaluable for every scenario.
method: Full Engine reactive bubble-point solve for every endpoint and state. Reaction endpoints modify the authoritative coefficient_values metadata before Engine problem compilation.

scipy_spot_check.method: Five reaction extents with Engine fixed-pressure composition derivatives, initialized at 0.999 times the Engine-root extents and evaluated at the Engine bubble pressure.
scipy_spot_check.claim_limit: Confirms reaction-equation and nonlinear-root consistency at one state; it is not an independent EOS or bubble-point validation.
